title: Multi-hit attacks
problem: The bonus pool is never reset between hits: hit k gets the bonuses of hits 1..k (150/200/250/300 instead of 150×4). Large impact.
notes: In-game test: Effectively confirmed in game by the community: their Touch of Red numbers (480 / 640 / 800 for +2 attacks at 320 base) are exactly this pool growth (community_vet_B6). Fix touches every multi-hit "more damage" bonus: a balance call. Fix: H: reset per hit Also confirmed by the community's Firelord (612) numbers (SU-0152). Also confirmed by the community's Touch of Red (664) numbers (SU-0157). User 2026-10-26: normalize, no ramp. Fix: reset the attack's bonus pool at the start of each hit (pool zeroed at L10 / L88 only, hit loop L1076-L1892 in bc_CreatureAttack) so every hit gets each bonus once. After the fix, re-check the merged Touch of Red / Firelord against their texts: Touch of Red 'all attacks +25% for each attack' (3 attacks -> +75% each), Firelord '+20% per attack this battle' (same bonus on every hit of one attack). | In-game test: a 4-hit attack (e.g. +3 additional attacks) with one '% more damage' bonus active: all four hits deal the same damage (no 150/200/250/300 ramp). Touch of Red after the fix: each hit gets +25% per additional attack (2 extra attacks -> +50% on every hit, not the text's +75% for 3 attacks); Firelord: every hit gets the same +20% x attacks-this-battle, matching its text.

release_notes.intended: Each hit of an attack gets each '% more damage' bonus once.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonuses piled up from hit to hit, so later hits grew much stronger than the first (e.g. 150%, 200%, 250%, 300%).
release_notes.fix: Now every hit of the attack gets each bonus once, so all hits deal the same damage. Touch of Red's count is corrected separately (SU-0176).
